mcp.name: config-approval
mcp.description: See who asked to change sensitive configuration (job pauses, schedules, parameters), why, and what is still waiting for approval.

tool.name: get_config_change_digest
tool.title: Get Config Change Digest
tool.description: Summary of configuration change activity for the last N hours (default 24): how many change requests were made and decided, what is still waiting for approval and for how long, and approved job pauses that look forgotten (planned fix date passed and the job is still paused, or paused for days with no fix date). Use this for the daily summary. digestText is ready to quote; digest has the same data as structure.

tool.name: get_config_change_requests
tool.title: Get Config Change Requests
tool.description: List configuration change requests, newest first, with the requester's reason, planned fix date, decision and the field-by-field change. Filter by statusId (CcrPending, CcrApplied, CcrRejected, CcrCancelled, CcrFailed, CcrExpired), requestedByUserId, entityName or requestedDate_from / requestedDate_thru. Stored secrets are never returned.
